svg.font-family: Inter,'Noto Sans SC','Source Han Sans SC','Microsoft YaHei','PingFang SC','Hiragino Sans GB',Segoe UI,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif
svg.text: LINE 1 - A-type, 6 cars - catenary 1500 V DC - no PSD
over-ground: the platform is open to the weather
B-type, third rail, platform screen doors
plaza, bus + taxi kerb, two entrances
fare gates - each gate carries its own throughput
boarding (green out) / alighting (yellow in) - the train is a queue with a schedule
Line 1 is over-ground: catenary, weather on the platform, no screen doors.
Line 2 sits behind platform screen doors at B2 - boarding is gated per door.
Line 3 at B3 turns every transfer into a vertical walk with a queue at the top.
Escalator, stair and lift are assets, each with its own capacity and speed.
A transfer passenger is a real agent: walk, queue, gate, wait, board.
Depth is not decoration. It is walk time, queue time and platform density.
